_comment: How many distinct collage arrangements the generator can actually choose
from, per photo count, for Dan's photos (every frame 3:2 landscape).
Generated from distinct_collage_splits filtered by split_fits_photos, the
same pair the renderer uses. Regenerate with tests/test_collage_arrangements.py,
which fails when this file and the live function disagree.
It exists so the Swift upload page can decide whether to offer a 'New
layout' button without reimplementing the split enumeration, which would
drift from the crop budget rules (#195). Both languages read this one file.
A count of 1 means rerolling redraws the identical collage. A count of 0
means nothing fits the crop budget and the renderer falls back to a single
forced layout, so there is nothing to reroll there either.
